what: impl_identity (publish.rs) hashes an impl by ImplLoc only (crate, module names, ast id), so impl_row_hash/blanket_hash miss edits of an impl header (where clauses, generics, assoc type values) and change on a module rename. As the item store Implements fact value that is unsound. Proposal: impl_identity reads an impl-identity hook installed once per database; blaze-item-hash installs it as (crate, blaze_items signature_hash of the impl, ordinal among equal-signature impls of the crate), name- and position-free (design docs/v2/plan/design/item-hash.md 3.7). Then lane items makes Implements = hash over crates in scope of impl_row_hash for unifying heads plus blanket_hash. Sent to window dbsp-impls-next1 too.
